feature: LMS.ProgressService (Phase 1 #6) — lesson + course completion tracking with MassTransit outbox

tasks.title: Add LessonCompleted + CourseCompleted records to LMS.Contracts
tasks.spec: Create src/LMS.Contracts/Progress/LessonCompleted.cs and src/LMS.Contracts/Progress/CourseCompleted.cs as sealed records matching the shapes locked in contracts.md section 3 (no EventId; idempotency on natural keys). Namespace: LMS.Contracts.Progress. No consumers wired in this task — pure contract.

tasks.title: Scaffold ProgressService 4-project layout
tasks.spec: Use /scaffold-service style: create src/services/LMS.ProgressService/{Domain,Infrastructure,Api,Migrator} csproj files with the references locked in contracts.md section 1. Add to LMS.slnx. NuGet packages per contracts. Empty Program.cs in Api + Migrator (compiles). Do NOT add entities or DbContext yet (T3/T4 do that).

tasks.title: Domain layer — entities, enums, DTOs, ITenantContext
tasks.spec: In LMS.ProgressService.Domain: add Entities/LessonProgress.cs, Entities/CourseProgress.cs, Enums/ProgressStatus.cs (per contracts.md section 2 and docs/entities.md). Add Dtos/ for CompleteLessonRequest, LessonProgressDto, CourseProgressDto, CourseProgressSummaryDto, LessonAnalyticsDto. Add Tenancy/ITenantContext.cs interface (TenantId getter) — match EnrollmentService pattern.

tasks.title: Infrastructure — ProgressDbContext, EF config, MassTransit consumers
tasks.spec: Implement ProgressDbContext (schema=progress, two DbSets, global TenantId filter via reflection over TenantEntity descendants, indexes per contracts section 2, xmin row version). Add UserEnrolledConsumer + EnrollmentCancelledConsumer in Consumers/. Add MassTransit DI extension with AddEntityFrameworkOutbox<ProgressDbContext>, retry Intervals(1s,5s,30s). Implement HttpContextTenantContext.cs reading X-Tenant-Id. Reference LMS.Contracts.Enrollment.UserEnrolled and EnrollmentCancelled. Behaviour per contracts section 3.

tasks.title: Initial EF Core migration + Migrator host
tasks.spec: Generate migration 20260427_001_InitialProgressSchema covering: schema progress, tables lesson_progress + course_progress with all columns/indexes per contracts section 2, plus MassTransit outbox/inbox/state tables in same schema. Implement Migrator/Program.cs as IHostedService that runs db.Database.MigrateAsync() once and exits 0. Match EnrollmentService.Migrator pattern.

tasks.title: Api — Minimal API endpoints, validators, Program.cs, gateway route
tasks.spec: Implement Program.cs (Minimal API) with all endpoints from contracts.md section 5. Header tenancy middleware (X-Tenant-Id required, 400 TENANT_REQUIRED). FluentValidation validator for CompleteLessonRequest (CourseId non-empty; WatchPercent in [0,100] else INVALID_WATCH_PERCENT). Endpoint handlers implement the recompute semantics in section 5 (atomic upsert + outbox publish of LessonCompleted, conditional CourseCompleted on transition to 100%). Authorization via X-Roles header (instructor/admin for analytics; student for self routes). Wire gateway: append progress route + cluster to src/gateway/LMS.Gateway/appsettings.json. Update src/services/LMS.ProgressService/LMS.ProgressService.Api/Properties/launchSettings.json with port 5106.

tasks.title: AppHost wiring — register progress + progress-migrator resources
tasks.spec: Apply the locked diff in contracts.md section 6 to src/LMS.AppHost/Program.cs: AddDatabase('lms-progress'), AddProject<Projects.LMS_ProgressService_Migrator>('progress-migrator') with WaitFor(progressDb), AddProject<Projects.LMS_ProgressService_Api>('progress') with WithReference(progressDb)+WithReference(rabbitmq)+WaitForCompletion(progressMigrator), gateway.WithReference(progress). Remove the stale `// builder.AddProject<Projects.LMS_ProgressService>` comment.

tasks.title: Integration + unit + architecture + contract tests
tasks.spec: Add tests under tests/LMS.IntegrationTests/ProgressService/ using xunit-integration skill (Testcontainers Postgres + RabbitMQ + MassTransit harness + Keycloak header stub). Cover every scenario in contracts.md section 8 (tenant pair, complete-lesson happy path + idempotency, CourseCompleted-once on transition, UserEnrolled consumer upsert, EnrollmentCancelled consumer touches LastAccessedAt only, analytics 403). Add unit tests for validator + recompute helper + DTO mapping. Add architecture assertions in LMS.ArchitectureTests for TenantEntity inheritance + global filter. Add contract tests in LMS.ContractTests asserting LessonCompleted/CourseCompleted record shapes.

tasks.title: Tenant-isolation + JWT-trust audit on ProgressService
tasks.spec: Run tenant-isolation skill against ProgressService surface. Verify: every entity inherits TenantEntity, global query filter applied for both DbSets, no endpoint re-validates JWT, X-User-Id used only as identity (never trusted for tenant), consumers stamp TenantId from event payload (not HttpContext), analytics endpoint cannot leak cross-tenant rows. Produce a structured finding list — empty list = pass.
acceptance: audit report has zero high/critical findings

tasks.title: End-to-end review against contracts.md + absolute rules
tasks.spec: Run code-reviewer skill across all branches T1–T9. Check: contracts.md section-by-section compliance, absolute rules (TenantEntity, global filter, no direct HTTP between services, JWT only at gateway, events as records in LMS.Contracts), DAG of services in AppHost, idempotency keys on consumers, outbox usage on every Publish, error-shape consistency. Block on any contract violation.

tasks.title: Update docs to reflect shipped ProgressService
tasks.spec: Create docs/services/progress.md (NEW under services/ — copy from existing docs/progress.md, fix port to 5106, drop deferred features to a 'Phase 2+' section, document the 7 open decisions from contracts.md section 9). Update docs/architecture.md service map to include progress at port 5106. Update docs/events.md routing table — confirm LessonCompleted/CourseCompleted publishers + consumers match what shipped. Append an entry to docs/adr-index.md only if a new ADR is warranted (likely not — open decisions extend ADR-004).
